ui.landingIntro: Ippo Care is a personal health companion for iPhone. It brings your Apple Health data, meals and workouts together, helps you set goals, and grows a small city with your real progress. Here you can read how it treats your data, the terms for using it, and how to get help.
highlights: No account and no developer-run health database. Your records live on your device.
No advertising, no analytics SDKs, and Apple Health data is never sold.
The assistant is optional and only uses the provider and key you set up.
ui.reply: Usually replies within two business days

privacy.title: Summary
bullets: Ippo Care has no developer-operated account system and no developer-operated health database. Your profile, records, journal and conversations are stored on your iPhone.
Apple Health data is read only with your permission, is never used for advertising or marketing, and is never sold or rented.
The app contains no advertising, no third-party analytics and no tracking SDKs, and does not track you across apps or websites.
AI is optional. Content is sent to an AI provider only when you configure one with your own API key and start a task that needs it.
You can export or delete your data in the app at any time, and revoke permissions in iOS Settings or the Health app.

privacy.title: 1. Who we are and what this policy covers
paragraphs: Ippo Care (the "App") is developed and provided by Yusen Wang, an individual developer ("we", "us"). We are the party responsible for the processing described in this policy. Contact: wm88889@hotmail.com.

This policy applies to the Ippo Care app for iPhone and to these privacy, terms and support pages. It does not apply to third-party services you choose to connect, such as Apple Health data sources, AI providers or websites opened from the App; those services have their own policies.
Ippo Care helps you record, organize and understand personal health, fitness and wellbeing information. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, treatment or prescriptions.

privacy.title: 2. Information the App processes
paragraphs: Because the App works on your device, "processing" below mostly means processing on your iPhone. We, the developer, do not receive this information unless you send it to us yourself, for example in a support email.
bullets: Profile information you enter: height, date of birth, sex used for training heart-rate zones and the muscle-map body figure, unit and appearance preferences, goals and progress.

Apple Health data you authorize: for example sleep, steps, activity and energy, heart rate, resting heart rate, heart-rate variability, workouts, body measurements and other categories you choose. The App reads this data; it does not write to or modify Apple Health.
Records you create: meals, supplements, workouts, sets and weights, body measurements, notes, photos you attach and other journal entries.

Assistant conversations: the text you type or dictate, attachments you choose, the assistant's replies, generated cards, and, if you enable assistant memory, short facts the assistant saves to personalize later replies.
AI configuration: the provider, service address, model names, feature switches and API keys you enter.

Purchase and trial status: the trial's start time (once you start it) and latest-use time, used to calculate the trial, and the product, transaction and entitlement information returned by Apple StoreKit.

Optional Sign in with Apple: if you use it, Apple may share a stable identifier and, depending on your choice, your name and a real or relay email address. It is used only to associate your local profile and is never required to buy or restore the Full Unlock.
Technical information kept on the device: app settings, caches, and local diagnostic logs used to keep the App working. These are not sent to us automatically.

privacy.title: 3. How the information is used
bullets: To show your daily status, trends, charts, goals, badges and the City that grows with your real activity.
To save and display the records you create and to let you edit, export or delete them.
To carry out assistant tasks you start, such as answering a question, logging a meal or workout from your description or photo, planning, or explaining an exercise.
To calculate the free trial, verify the Full Unlock and restore purchases.
To keep the App secure and working, and to answer messages you send to us.

We do not use your information for advertising, profiling for marketing, data brokering or training our own AI models. We do not sell or rent personal information, and we do not "share" it for cross-context behavioral advertising.

privacy.title: 4. Apple Health and system permissions
paragraphs: The App asks for Apple Health read access for the categories it can use. You choose which categories to allow, and iOS does not tell the App which read permissions you declined; missing data simply stays missing. The App does not write to Apple Health.

Data obtained through Apple HealthKit is used only to provide the App's health and fitness features to you. It is not used for advertising or other data-mining purposes, not disclosed to third parties for those purposes, not sold, and not stored in iCloud by the App.

Health data leaves your device only if you turn on AI health analysis in Privacy and permissions and start a task that needs it; in that case only the data the task needs is sent to the AI provider you configured (see section 5).

Camera, photo library, microphone and speech recognition are requested only when you use a feature that needs them. You can change every permission at any time in iOS Settings, and Apple Health permissions in the Health app under Sharing › Apps and Services › Ippo Care. Revoking access stops future reads; it does not delete copies already saved in the App, which you can delete in the App's data controls.

privacy.title: 5. Optional AI features and third-party recipients
paragraphs: The assistant only works with an AI provider you choose and an API key you supply. Ippo Care does not run its own model service, does not resell model access, and the Full Unlock does not include AI usage. The provider bills you directly under its own terms.

When you start an assistant task, the App sends the provider what that task needs: your message, relevant conversation context, attachments you selected, and, only if AI health analysis is enabled, the health records needed for the task. The provider also receives technical data needed for any internet request, such as your IP address.

Supported providers currently include OpenAI, DeepSeek, Anthropic (Claude), Alibaba Cloud Qwen, Google Gemini, xAI, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, Moonshot Kimi, Zhipu, MiniMax, Volcengine Ark and other compatible addresses you enter. Only the provider you configure for a task receives that task's request. Different tasks (for example chat, image generation, video generation or online speech) can use different providers if you set them up that way.

If you enable web search, the search query and the addresses of pages to read are sent to the configured search service or provider. General literature searches may be sent to PubMed / NCBI. Search queries are built from general terms; the App instructs the assistant not to include your name or personal records in them.

If you choose an online voice or an image or video generation service, the text to be read aloud or the prompt and inputs for generation are sent to that service. The default read-aloud voice uses Apple's on-device system voices.

Each provider decides where it processes data, how long it keeps it, and whether it is used to train models. Some providers process data outside your country or region. Please read the privacy policy of the provider you choose. Turning off AI or deleting a provider stops future requests but does not delete copies already held by the provider; contact the provider to delete them.
API keys are stored in the iOS Keychain, are sent only to the provider they belong to for authentication, are never included in exports, and are never placed into conversation content.

privacy.title: 6. Where data is stored and how it is protected
paragraphs: Profiles, records, journals, conversations and attachments are stored in the App's private storage on your iPhone. The App encrypts its local database, keeps database keys and API keys in the iOS Keychain, and relies on iOS data protection. Device backups you make with iCloud or a computer may include App data according to your backup settings and Apple's terms.
No method of storage or transmission is completely secure. Please protect your device with a passcode, keep exported files safe, and only send data to services you trust.

We do not operate servers that receive your health records. Widgets and Live Activities display information you have chosen to show on your Home Screen or Lock Screen, where people with access to your device may see it.

privacy.title: 7. How long data is kept
bullets: Profile, records, journal and conversations: until you delete them in the App or delete the App.
Assistant memory: until you delete the memory item, turn the feature off and clear it, or delete the App.
Exported files: temporary export files inside the App are removed after about ten minutes; copies you saved or shared elsewhere are under your control.
Trial timestamps in the Keychain: may remain after the App is deleted so that the free trial cannot be restarted; they contain no health information.
Purchase records: kept by Apple under Apple's policies.
Support emails: kept only as long as needed to handle your request and any follow-up, normally no more than two years, unless the law requires longer.

privacy.title: 8. Your choices and rights
bullets: Access and export: Settings › Privacy and permissions › Export or delete data creates a copy of your records you can save or share.
Correction: edit your profile, records and goals directly in the App.
Deletion: delete individual records or all App data in the App. Deleting data in the App does not delete original data in Apple Health or copies held by AI providers.
Withdraw consent: turn off AI health analysis, remove AI providers and keys, or revoke system permissions at any time. Withdrawal does not affect processing that took place before.

Contact us: email wm88889@hotmail.com to ask a question, make a request or complain. Because we do not hold your App data on our servers, most requests are fulfilled directly in the App; we will explain how. Please do not send health records, ID documents, passwords or API keys in your first message.
You may also complain to the data protection authority where you live.

privacy.title: 9. Additional information for specific regions
bullets: United Kingdom and similar laws: we process data to provide the App you asked for (contract), with your explicit consent for health data and for sending data to an AI provider, and for our legitimate interest in keeping the App secure. You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, and may complain to the Information Commissioner's Office.

United States, including California and other states with privacy laws: we do not sell personal information, do not share it for cross-context behavioral advertising, and do not use sensitive personal information to infer characteristics about you. You may request to know, delete or correct personal information, and we will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights. Consumer health data you provide is used only to deliver the features you request.

Japan (APPI): health information is special care-required personal information and is acquired only with your consent. When you choose an AI provider located outside Japan, data is provided to that provider at your direction; please check the provider's policy for its country and safeguards.

Republic of Korea (PIPA): health information is sensitive information and is processed only with your separate consent. Data is sent abroad only to the AI provider you choose, at the time you start a task, and you can stop this by turning AI off.

Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macao, Singapore and Malaysia: we collect personal data only for the purposes described here, keep it only as long as needed, and handle access and correction requests sent to the contact address.
Canada, Australia and New Zealand: you may request access to and correction of personal information we hold about you and complain to the relevant privacy commissioner.
We aim to respond to verified requests within 30 days, or sooner where local law requires.

privacy.title: 10. Children
paragraphs: Ippo Care is a general-audience health and fitness app and is not directed to children under 13 (or the minimum age in your country). Minors should use it only with a parent or guardian's involvement, and AI providers may set their own minimum ages.
If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, contact us and we will take appropriate steps, including deleting it.

privacy.title: 11. These web pages
paragraphs: These pages are static documents hosted on GitHub Pages. They contain no forms, cookies, advertising or analytics scripts. GitHub may process technical information such as your IP address to deliver the pages and keep them secure, under GitHub's own privacy statement.
If you email us, your email provider and ours process the message.

privacy.title: 12. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We will update this policy when the App's features or data practices change. The date at the top shows the latest version, and the full change history is public in the repository that publishes these pages. If a change materially affects how your data is used, we will tell you in the App and ask for consent again where required.

privacy.title: 13. Contact

AI providers may require you to be older; you must meet their requirements to use their services.

terms.title: 4. Not medical advice
paragraphs: Ippo Care is a personal wellness and fitness tool. It is not a medical device, and it does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Scores such as the recovery trend, charts, badges, the City, assistant replies and exercise guides are for general information and motivation only.

Always seek the advice of a physician or other qualified health professional about a medical condition, medication, diet or training program, and before starting or changing exercise. Never ignore professional advice or delay seeking it because of something in the App.
If you think you may have a medical emergency, contact your local emergency number immediately. The App cannot call for help and does not monitor you.

terms.title: 5. Health data and accuracy
paragraphs: The App relies on data from Apple Health, connected devices and what you enter. That data can be incomplete, delayed or inaccurate, and estimates such as energy, sleep stages or recovery can differ from clinical measurements. You are responsible for checking important information against reliable sources.
You keep all rights in the data and content you create. The App processes it on your device only to provide its features to you.

terms.title: 6. Optional AI assistant
paragraphs: The assistant is optional and works only with a third-party AI provider and API key that you choose. Your use of that provider is governed by the provider's own terms and policies, and the provider charges you directly. We are not responsible for a provider's availability, pricing, data practices or outputs.

AI output can be wrong, incomplete, outdated or inappropriate, even when it sounds confident. Do not rely on it for medical, nutritional, legal or financial decisions. Review records the assistant creates before relying on them, and use the App's undo and edit controls if something is wrong.

You are responsible for the content you send to a provider and for keeping your API keys secure. Do not submit content you do not have the right to share, or other people's personal information without their permission.

Images or videos generated by AI are illustrations and must not be used as exercise technique demonstrations or medical images. Some providers offer optional safety checks; turning them off may expose you to unsuitable output.

terms.title: 7. Exercise, nutrition and safety
paragraphs: Exercise guides, demonstrations, plans and nutrition information in the App are general references. They have not been reviewed for your personal circumstances. Exercise involves a risk of injury. Warm up, use appropriate loads, stop immediately if you feel pain, dizziness, chest discomfort or shortness of breath, and consult a qualified coach, physiotherapist or physician before unfamiliar or heavy training. You participate in any activity at your own risk to the extent permitted by law.

terms.title: 8. Free features, trial and Full Unlock
bullets: Today and City are free to use without time limit.

You can start one free trial of every feature whenever you choose; it lasts 72 consecutive hours from the moment you start it. Nothing starts automatically: you may also keep using the free features without ever starting the trial. The trial never charges you, never renews and does not turn into a subscription.

After the trial, the remaining features can be unlocked permanently with the one-time, non-consumable Full Unlock in-app purchase. It is not a subscription and does not renew. The price is shown in the App before you buy and may vary by region and tax.

Purchases are processed by Apple under Apple's terms. Payment, receipts and refunds are handled by Apple; to request a refund, use Apple's "Report a Problem" page. We cannot issue refunds directly. Your statutory rights are not affected.
You can restore the Full Unlock on devices signed in with the same Apple Account using Restore Purchases. Family Sharing applies only if it is enabled for the product in the App Store.
The Full Unlock does not include fees charged by AI providers or other third-party services.
We may add, change or remove features over time. If we materially reduce a paid feature you bought, we will try to provide a reasonable alternative where we can.

If you send us feedback or suggestions, we may use them freely without obligation to you.

terms.title: 20. Contact
paragraphs: Yusen Wang, developer of Ippo Care. Email: wm88889@hotmail.com.

support.title: Contact the developer
paragraphs: Email wm88889@hotmail.com. We usually reply within two business days. Please include your iPhone model, iOS version and the Ippo Care version shown at the bottom of Settings, what you did, what you expected and what happened. Screenshots help, but please cover health details first. Never send your Apple Account password or AI API keys.

support.title: What is free, and what does the Full Unlock include?
paragraphs: Today and City are free forever. You can start a free 72-hour trial of every feature whenever you choose. After that, a one-time Full Unlock permanently unlocks Health, Goals, Trends, the assistant and the rest. It is not a subscription and the trial never charges you or renews.

support.title: How do I restore my purchase?
paragraphs: Make sure the device is signed in to the Apple Account that bought the Full Unlock, then open Settings › Ippo Care full version › Restore Purchases. No Ippo Care account is needed.

support.title: How do I get a refund?
paragraphs: Apple processes all App Store payments, so refunds are requested from Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com or through your purchase history. We cannot see your payment details or issue refunds directly.

support.title: Apple Health shows no data or the wrong data
paragraphs: Open the Health app › Sharing › Apps and Services › Ippo Care and make sure the categories you want are allowed. Then open Ippo Care › Data sources and pull down to refresh. New Apple Watch or iPhone readings can take a few minutes to arrive in Apple Health. Ippo Care only reads Apple Health; it never changes your Health records.

support.title: Setting up the AI assistant
paragraphs: Open Settings › AI assistant, choose a provider, paste an API key from that provider's website and pick a model. Usage is billed by the provider, not by Ippo Care. If you see an authentication or quota error, check the key, the balance and the model name on the provider's website. The assistant reads your health records only if you turn on AI health analysis in Privacy and permissions.

support.title: Export, back up or delete your data
paragraphs: Your data lives on your iPhone. Use Settings › Privacy and permissions › Export or delete data to save a copy or erase it. Keep an export or an iPhone backup before changing devices, because there is no Ippo Care cloud copy.

support.title: Is Ippo Care medical advice?
paragraphs: No. Ippo Care supports personal wellness and fitness. It does not diagnose or treat conditions. Talk to a qualified health professional about medical questions, and call your local emergency number in an emergency.

support.title: Policies
paragraphs: Read the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service linked at the top of this page. Purchases are also subject to Apple's Standard EULA.
